name: Travel Pace
desc: While traveling, a group moves at a fast, normal, or slow pace. A fast pace covers 4 miles per hour (30 per day) but imposes a -5 penalty to passive Wisdom (Perception). A normal pace covers 3 miles per hour (24 per day). A slow pace covers 2 miles per hour (18 per day) but lets travelers move stealthily. These figures assume relatively simple terrain; difficult terrain and other factors can slow travel.
